source_name: Zákon č. 211/2000 Z. z. §5a + zákon č. 546/2010 Z. z. — publication duty and exemptions
why_relevant: Defines the boundary of this whole layer: which contracts must be published in full, which are published only as a summary notice of conclusion (§5a ods. 5 letters incl. c, d, i, j, r, s — the group that covers financial-instrument and payment-service-provision contracts), and which entity is exempt (sources state only NBS retains an exemption since 31.3.2022). Essential for calibrating coverage claims and for knowing when an absent contract means 'exempt' rather than 'no deal'.

source_name: MIRRI – call for expert evaluators of IT projects (Program Slovensko)
why_relevant: Recruitment of external evaluators for measures 1.2.1/1.2.2/1.4.2/1.5.1 is itself a staffing signal that a wave of IT grant decisions — and consequent procurements — is imminent, and it names the exact measures involved.

source_name: MF SR – projektové zámery informatizácie (manažérske výstupy I-02, e.g. eFaktúra)
why_relevant: Concrete example of a published 'projektový zámer' for the eFaktúra (e-invoicing) project — a payments-adjacent state system. Such I-02 documents specify modules, integration points and indicative procurement lots long before tender.

source_name: Asseco CE – 'Napísali o nás' (press clippings incl. 'Banky sa svojimi IT dodávateľmi nechvália')
why_relevant: Directly documents the structural problem of this cell — Slovak banks conceal their IT suppliers — and names vendors/relationships in the process. Excellent seed for actor mapping and for understanding disclosure incentives.

source_name: Forbes Slovensko – article on Slovak banks not naming IT suppliers
why_relevant: Independent business-press mapping of who supplies which Slovak bank; supplies vendor names to add to the actor map and is a recurring outlet for vendor-side disclosure.

Law-firm blog explaining procurement rules and advising both contracting authorities and bidders; representative of the law-firm blog layer that flags rule changes affecting bank/payment service tenders.

source_name: NR SR parliamentary document library – NKÚ reports tabled in parliament
why_relevant: NKÚ annual and thematic audit reports are submitted to the National Council and stored as downloadable PDFs there. Useful as an alternative/archival copy when nku.gov.sk restructures URLs, and it captures the parliamentary debate around findings.

source_name: PosAm – Referencie (e.g. Tatra banka IT outsourcing case)
why_relevant: PosAm publishes a named Tatra banka outsourcing reference describing the 2014 tender and 2015 transition — a concrete vendor-side disclosure of a Slovak bank procurement outcome and timeline.

source_name: Postoj — coverage of ÚVO ruling extending procurement duty to Dôvera and Union
why_relevant: Reveals a structural change in the buyer universe: private health insurers Dôvera and Union may become obliged buyers, which would add two large new procurement profiles for banking/payment services.

source_name: sk.openprocurements.com – per-tender mirrored pages for NBS
why_relevant: Aggregator that mirrors individual Slovak tenders as stable, crawlable static pages — useful as a historical archive when ÚVO/JOSEPHINE pages rotate. The example is precisely an NBS banknote-processing-equipment servicing tender.

source_name: teraz.sk — TASR procurement reporting on state buyers
why_relevant: State news agency reports launches, values and cancellations of large state-buyer tenders (e.g. Slovenská pošta logistics IS ~EUR 13.7m) often on the day of publication — a low-latency trigger to go look at the buyer profile.

source_name: Your Europe / e-Justice – EU-level explainer on requesting review of a SK procurement procedure
why_relevant: Confirms ÚVO as the designated SK review body under the EU Remedies Directives and gives the EN/SK bilingual framing needed to map SK remedy terminology to EU concepts; e-Justice mirrors the national case-law access points.
